description: A persisted summary standing in for a contiguous run of early Chat Messages. The read path sends the summary plus the verbatim tail that follows it, so covered messages are never re-sent. Summaries chain: each one supersedes the previous, absorbing its text.

fields.description: The agent whose turn produced this summary, when known. Recorded for provenance only — the read path keys on the conversation.
fields.label: Agent

fields.description: Prefixed to the recent verbatim tail on the next dispatch, in place of every message in the covered range.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: The exact run of messages this summary stands in for. Everything at or before Covered Upto is covered; everything after it is sent verbatim.
fields.label: Covered Range

fields.description: Oldest message covered. Recorded for audit; the read path filters on Covered Upto so a deleted message cannot break it.
fields.label: Covered From

fields.description: Creation timestamp of the newest covered message. This is the cursor the read path uses: a message is sent verbatim only when its creation is strictly later. A tie is treated as covered, so a boundary collision can only under-include — never re-send.
fields.label: Covered Upto

fields.description: The summary this one absorbs and replaces. Only the newest summary in a conversation is ever read; the chain is kept so a compaction can be audited or unwound.
fields.label: Supersedes

name: Chat Conversation Summary
